    About

    Private Links helps you share links without known tracking and sharing IDs.

    Your privacy

    Some share links carry a unique ID that can tie a click back to the original sharer or their account. Forwarding the same link can pass that ID to people you never intended to share it with.

    We don’t store copies of the links you share or clean on our servers. If you use History, cleaned links and timestamps are saved only on this device.

    Platforms can still log visits and identify signed-in users.
